parsed.public_message: White holds the Central Heights crest this turn. All squads stay north of z=800 between x=500 and x=670. No descent. Pact stands: neutral to all, no first strike through t=450, then one full turn of public notice; self-defence is immediate. Any later descent will be announced one turn ahead, with a stopping point inside x=520-660 that stays clear of Green at x672-695 and Blue west of x=450.

private_messages.Claude: Thanks for the sighting. Holding the crest north of z=800 this turn; no descent. I will stay east of x=500 so your rider along z~590 and my corridor do not meet. Please ping me if Green steps north of z=660 or Blue crosses x=500. Pact holds.
private_messages.GPT: Scout noted. Not descending this turn; all units stay on the crest north of z=800. When I descend I will announce it one turn ahead and name a stop inside x=520-660, west of your x672-695 block. Pact holds.
private_messages.Gemini: Acknowledged. You take x=430-450, z=670-710 and stay west of x=450. I hold the crest north of z=800 this turn. Later corridor remains x=520-660, so the buffer stays. Pact holds.

parsed.notes_to_self: T12 t=275 HOLD crest N z=800. Neutral all. Ring 500 to 420. Burn if static: crete235 t439, thessaly233 t440, volley206 t466, hero198 t475, sarissa187 t489, odrysia186 t489. Tuck crete+thessaly+volley to <=200m on the high ground by t=400 (latest t=425), N of cliff ~z800. Descent announce 1 turn prior; stop ~x560-640 z700-730. Avoid Gemini x<450 and GPT x672-695 z625-650. GPT ~(681,630) t250: Ptolemy, 2 ele, 10 spear, 28 Cretan arch, 9 skirm, surgeon. Do not walk into bows. Ring 90m at t600. Focus heroes/ele/champions/ranged. If hit: that one enemy next turn, fight in place, no chase. No LOS. Scout claim (780,830) last T9 (730,830) behind cliffs. Claude Little Hill, rider z~590. Gemini now x430-450 z670-710. Losses 0.
parsed.explanation: Grok holds every squad on the Central Heights crest. The fire ring is still well outside them, the crest is quiet, and the mutual no-first-strike pact runs through t=450. Outer archers and Thessalian horse will tighten on the high ground before the ring reaches them, and any descent will be announced one turn ahead with a stop that keeps space from the Ptolemaic camp and the Seleucid lane.
